name: Quail
intro: A quail is a small, round bird. It lives mostly on the ground.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A quail is a small, plump bird.
It has a short neck and a small head.
Its feathers are brown, gray, and white.
A bobwhite is about as long as a robin.
A California quail has a curly feather on its head.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Quails spend most of their time on the ground.
Bobwhites live in fields, farms, and the edges of woods.
California quails live on the West Coast.
They hide under bushes and tall plants.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Quails eat seeds, berries, and leaves.
They also eat flowers and acorns.
They eat bugs like beetles and caterpillars.
Bobwhites eat more bugs in the summer.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A quail makes its nest on the ground.
The nest is a small dip lined with grass.
A bobwhite mom lays about 12 to 16 eggs.
The chicks leave the nest soon after they hatch.
Mom and dad both take care of the chicks.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: A group of quails is called a covey.
A bobwhite whistles its name: bob-WHITE!
At night, bobwhites sleep in a circle.
The California quail is California's state bird.
Quails are related to chickens and turkeys.

vocab.meaning: A small group of quails that stay together.
A place a bird makes to lay its eggs.
A curly feather on top of a quail's head.
